page.overview:
Who is Reuben Delgado?

Teresa Delgado (older daughter)Isabella Delgado (younger daughter)}} Reuben Delgado is a father and a character in . He was stranded on Ile Saint-Hubert with his family.

Reuben Delgado married a woman and had two daughters, Teresa and Isabella. In 2027, Teresa was accepted into New York University. Wanting to have one last family adventure before she left, Reuben took his two daughters sailing in the Atlantic Ocean on his boat, La Mariposa. Teresa also brought along her boyfriend, Xavier Dobbs, to which Reuben reluctantly agreed to.

As Rueben's sailboat neared Ile Saint-Hubert, they were capsized by a Mosasaurus as it perceived their boat to be a competitor in its territory. Reuben, Teresa, Isabella, and Xavier survived the incident and managed to retrieve the radio in which Reuben spent the night calling for help. The following day, they were discovered by The Essex. The crew aboard were mercenaries led by Duncan Kincaid and Zora Bennett, assisted by paleontologist Doctor Henry Loomis. They were employed by Martin Krebs, a representative for Parker-Genix Pharmaceutical Engineering. They were bound for Ile Saint-Hubert to obtain living tissue samples from three of the largest cloned dinosaurs on the island so their material could be used to develop a cure for heart disease. This was considered an illegal operation that Krebs wanted kept secret, and assured Reuben that he and his family would be dropped off at the village on the island as it's powered by geothermal energy.

The Mosasaurus was among the dinosaurs they were targeting, and Bennett was able to obtain a sample. However, as they approached the island, the Mosasaurus, along with a pack of Spinosaurs, attacked the ship. Crew member Bobby Atwater was killed by a Spinosaurus in front of Reuben's family. Kincaid drove the ship towards the island in shallow waters to keep the boat from getting further attacked, but this required everyone jumping ship. Reuben had Teresa go to the radio and call for help. Desperate to keep the mission a secret, Krebs followed Teresa and kept her from radioing for help. As the boat was struck, Teresa fell overboard due to Krebs intentionally letting her fall. Xavier went in the waters after her, followed by Reuben and Isabella. The family reunited, and Teresa revealed to Reuben that Krebs kept her from radioing for help and let her fall overboard. While the remaining Essex crew continued with their mission, Reuben led his family to the village by following the geothermal pipes. Along the way, Isabella encountered an Aquilops she named Dolores and brought along with them. Dolores was able to warn Reuben's family of nearby danger. The following night, Reuben thanked Xavier for saving his daughter. Xavier expressed inadequacy about himself compared to Teresa, not knowing why she loves him. Reuben assured him that he was good enough and that he shouldn't let other people make him think he's less than.
